title: Sam Leavitt Draws Attention as LSU Quarterback Ahead of 2027 Draft
seoTitle: LSU QB Sam Leavitt Draws Attention for 2027 NFL Draft
subtitle: Transferred from Arizona State, QB enters draft contention following coaching change
excerpt: LSU newcomer Sam Leavitt is generating buzz after moving to Lane Kiffin's program, with potential to significantly improve his 2027 draft stock.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Sam Leavitt arrived at LSU after a notable stint at Arizona State, where he led the team to the Big 12 title in 2024 and a playoff berth. The transfer coincided with Lane Kiffin's arrival as the team's head coach, generating high expectations for the quarterback's future in the 2026 season.

Transfer to LSU and New Coaching Leadership

The LSU program brought Leavitt in as part of its first transfer portal class, considered number one in college football. The quarterback now plays under Lane Kiffin, who arrived at the program after Brian Kelly's departure. Kiffin, who coached the Ole Miss Rebels for six seasons, has a history of strong offensive production for his quarterbacks.

Previous Performance at Arizona State

In 2024, Leavitt threw for 2,885 yards, scored 24 touchdowns, and threw six interceptions, leading Arizona State to the Big 12 championship and a spot in the College Football Playoff. The following season was cut short by injury, limiting his play to seven games.

Draft Expectations According to Experts

Analyst Todd McShay stated that Leavitt has the potential to become the best quarterback in the 2027 class, although he was not included in Sports Illustrated's top ten NFL Draft rankings. The move to LSU could elevate his draft value, especially if he maintains his health and replicates the level of play shown in 2024.

Consistency Challenge and Path to Success

The main obstacle identified for Leavitt is consistency, as the 2025 season ended prematurely due to injury. The competitive environment of the SEC and the support of a talented roster at LSU offer him the opportunity to demonstrate that his best football is yet to come.

Potential for Draft Ascent

If Leavitt can put together a solid season under Kiffin's offensive scheme, his name could quickly rise in draft projections. While most predictions place him as a mid-round pick, an outstanding performance could lead him to be considered for the first round, changing the dynamic of a quarterback race that includes names like Arch Manning and Dante Moore.

With information from Sports Illustrated, ClutchPoints.
